title: Astronaut crew quarters: something came back with them

tellings.quote: never be the same. He said that every time that thing went up, when it came back down, something came with them and it was still there.

plain: The crew quarters at Cape Canaveral in the late 1950s were never the same, because every time a craft went up and came back down, something came back with the crew and stayed. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells Michels he heard this from a man named Timothy Taylor. Told this way, it suggests early space flights brought some unseen presence back to Earth.
